$comment: Canonical 2.0 marketing-site image manifest. The contract that docs/index.html (tablist + hero) and the OG/JSON-LD image reference. Real captures are produced by the screenshot pipeline (see scripts/capture-site-screenshots.md) from the built 2.0 .app; this file pins their final names, display dimensions, and byte budget so check-site-assets.mjs can gate them. Dimensions are LOGICAL points; a 2x (Retina) export at exactly double is also accepted.
